response:
Reviewing the 37 findings as a single "whole repo arrives at once" PR. Two structural caveats first, because they change how the scores should be read:

- **`churn`, `blast_radius`, and `recency` are 0 across every finding** — an empty baseline means no history and no importer graph to weigh. So `agent_risk` is compressed into a narrow 0.32–0.70 band and is doing less work than it normally would. I'm using it to break ties *within* a severity band, not as the primary axis.
- **`suppressed_count: 1`** (`crime_00017` is absent from the list) — one finding was filtered by config. Worth confirming that suppression is intentional and not hiding something in this diff.

**Policy I applied:** *Block* = produces wrong behaviour, or fails outside the author's machine, or is high-severity in load-bearing code with `agent_risk ≥ 0.55`. *Warn* = real and worth a follow-up but not merge-stopping. *Ignore* = local, cosmetic, single-site.

## Block merge (9)

| ID | Charge | sev / agent_risk | Why it blocks |
|---|---|---|---|
| `crime_00007` | Localhost-on-Disk | medium 0.6 / **0.53** | `/Users/andrew/dev/crimes/schema.json` @ `src/api/files.ts:9`. Severity understates it: this works on exactly one machine and fails on every CI runner and deploy. Confidence 0.9, effort *quick* — no reason to merge it. |
| `crime_00006` | Dev-Server URL | medium 0.6 / **0.53** | Same file, line 8: `localhost:3000` baked into non-config source. Same failure class — silently unreachable in every non-dev environment. |
| `crime_00003` | Half-UTC, Half-Local | high 0.8 / **0.61** | One receiver reads `getUTCFullYear()` @L9 and `getMonth()` @L41. This is a live correctness bug that only misbehaves at certain host offsets — the worst kind to ship. |
| `crime_00002` | Temporal Recklessness | high 0.8 / **0.62** | 8 clock reads in `src/date.ts`. Highest `agent_risk` in the date cluster and it's the file everything else defers to. Injecting a clock here is what makes 00003/00008 testable at all. |
| `crime_00008` | Timezone Roulette | medium 0.6 / **0.53** | `new Date("2026-12-25T07:00:00")` — runtime-dependent parse. Sub-block of the same defect; fix in the same pass as 00002/00003. |
| `crime_00004` | God Function | **high 0.9** / 0.55 | `generateInvoice`, 204 lines, 3.4× threshold. Highest severity in the report. This is new code — a function this size has never been reviewable, so there's no "pre-existing debt" defence. |
| `crime_00020` | False Identity | medium 0.55 / 0.44 | `calculateRefundPreview` calls `saveRefundAudit` and `sendRefundEmail`. A "preview" that emails the customer and writes an audit row is a behavioural bug, not a naming nit. `agent_risk` is low only because blast radius is unmeasurable here. |
| `crime_00027` | Logic in the Alibi | medium 0.5 / 0.42 | *"Only owners can refund enterprise plans unless billing support approves"* exists **only as a comment**, with the domain terms absent from nearby code. An unencoded authorisation rule sitting next to a side-effecting refund path (00020) is the one combination in this report I'd stop the merge over regardless of score. |
| `crime_00019` | Test That Proves Nothing | medium 0.45 / 0.46 | `"renders the enterprise plan"` has **zero** assertions. It's guarding the billing code that carries the two findings above. Green CI here means nothing, and that's worse than no test. |

## Warn (20)

| ID | Charge | sev / agent_risk | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `crime_00001` | SVG With Embedded Raster | high 0.75 / **0.70** | Highest `agent_risk` in the report, but I'm **not** blocking: nothing fails at runtime, blast radius is 0, effort *small*. This is where I disagree with the tool's severity — asset hygiene isn't merge-stopping. |
| `crime_00018` | Temporal Recklessness | medium 0.6 / 0.46 | 7 more clock reads in `billing.ts`. Rides along with the 00002 clock injection; warn on its own. |
| `crime_00024` / `crime_00025` | Date String Sewing / Host-Locale Drift | low 0.3 / 0.43 | Both in `date.ts`. Host-locale output is environment-dependent — fold into the blocked date rework rather than tracking separately. |
| `crime_00010` | DST-Naive Day Math | medium 0.6 / 0.52 | `+ 86400000`. Real, but fails twice a year, not on merge. |
| `crime_00023` | Temporal Recklessness | low 0.35 / 0.44 | Single `Date.now()` in `state.ts`. Cheap to fix with the rest. |
| `crime_00027`… see block | | | |
| `crime_00016` | Route Metadata Drift | medium 0.6 / 0.49 | `/settings/billing` labelled 4 different ways. Confidence 0.65 — needs a human to confirm which name is canonical, so warn not block. |
| `crime_00014` | Duplicated Navigation Source | medium 0.6 / 0.49 | Same destination, two labels (`Plans` / `Billing`) across two nav files. Same root cause as 00016. |
| `crime_00009` | String Sprinkles | medium 0.5 / 0.52 | `"enterprise"` in 4 files across 4 areas — and it's a *plan tier*, i.e. the thing the blocked refund rule keys off. Promote to a constant. |
| `crime_00012` | Concept Alias Drift | medium 0.55 / 0.51 | account/organisation/team/workspace all meaning "tenant" across 5 files. Confidence 0.75; a deliberate product decision could explain some of it. |
| `crime_00005` | Missing Agent Context | medium 0.6 / 0.53 | No AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, and `package.json` declares a bin. For a PR that *introduces* a repo, this is a reasonable merge condition to negotiate — I'd warn loudly rather than block. |
| `crime_00015` | Unfinished Business | medium 0.4 / 0.49 | 14 markers at 411/1k LOC in `src/todo.ts`. Signals the file is unfinished — ask whether it should ship at all. |
| `crime_00026` | God File | medium 0.6 / 0.42 | `billing.ts` at 311 lines, 1.0× threshold. Largely resolves itself once 00004 is extracted. |
| `crime_00022` | Sync I/O in Hot Path | low 0.4 / 0.44 | Three `*Sync` calls in `loadPlanSchema`. Same file as the two blocked hardcodes — fix in one pass. |
| `crime_00031` | Return Shape Roulette | low 0.3 / 0.40 | `resolvePaymentResult` returns 3 shapes with **0% key overlap**. Low score, but callers genuinely cannot discriminate the result. |
| `crime_00034` / `00035` / `00036` | Orphaned Destination ×3 | low 0.4 / 0.39 | `/account/subscription`, `/team`, `/workspace/members` unreachable from nav, docs, or imports. Confidence 0.65 and they may be in-flight — one question to the author, not a block. |
| `crime_00037` | Test That Proves Nothing | low 0.25 / 0.34 | `"creates an invoice"`, weak matcher only. Fix with 00019. |
| `crime_00021` | Docs-Code Drift | low 0.35 / 0.44 | `docs/teams.md:5 → ./setup.md` doesn't exist. One-line fix. |

## Ignore (8)

| ID | Charge | sev / agent_risk | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| `crime_00011` | Oversized Raster | low 0.4 / 0.52 | 253.9 KB, barely over the 200 KB low rung. `agent_risk` 0.52 is inflated by `test_gap: 1`, which is meaningless for a binary asset. |
| `crime_00013` | Icon-Sized Raster | low 0.35 / 0.50 | Same — a 32×32 PNG is a preference, not a defect. |
| `crime_00038` | Unfinished Business | low 0.2 / 0.32 | 4 markers at 12.9/1k vs a threshold of 10. Lowest scores in the report; noise. |
| `crime_00028` / `00029` | Unprefixed Boolean ×2 | low 0.3 / 0.42 | `paid`, `expired`, `stale`, `disableBilling`, `skipRetry`. Style. |
| `crime_00030` | Option Bag Junk Drawer | low 0.3 / 0.40 | Confidence 0.74 on a 6-property bag — plausible design choice. |
| `crime_00032` | Negative Flag Maze | low 0.25 / 0.40 | `!disableBilling && !skipRetry` is legible as written. |
| `crime_00033` | Plural Mismatch | low 0.3 / 0.40 | `users: User` / `invoice: Invoice[]`. Detector self-declares as v1 with known gaps. Worth a glance in case the type is genuinely wrong, but not review feedback. |

## The one thing the scores don't rank correctly

The report's own ordering puts `crime_00001` (SVG, `agent_risk` 0.70) at the top and `crime_00027` (unencoded refund authorisation rule, 0.42) at #27. I inverted that. `crime_00027` + `crime_00020` together describe a refund path where the access-control rule lives in prose and the "preview" function ships side effects — that's the actual risk in this PR, and no single score surfaces it because the signal is in the *pair*, not either finding. With `churn` and `blast_radius` unavailable, aggregate ranking can't see it.
